_note: Copied from the shipped TY 2026-27 timeline for W-146's synthetic pack, regime references renamed (NEW_TAX_REGIME -> SYN_DEFAULT, SYN_FLAT; FIRST_SCHEDULE_RATES -> SYN_CLASSIC); not law, never shipped. Original note: Interest for deferring advance tax, at each date on the shortfall from the share of the tax due on the returned income; none at June or September if 12 % or 36 % was paid. 2025 s.425(1) Table states 3 %; 1961 s.234C(1)(a)(i) states 'one per cent. per month for a period of three months', the same 3 %. The s.425(4) / s.234C carve-out for capital gains and dividends is not modelled (W-112a): a notice says so. Sources: sources/2026-11-06-advance-tax-interest.md; D-446.
